_comment: Codex-side MCP descriptor (ADR-0035). Codex never expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in plugin MCP command/args (openai/codex#35762 — hooks expand it, mcpServers leave it literal), so the shared .mcp.json's command is unresolvable there. Codex's native replacement is a relative cwd: 'cwd: .' resolves to the installed plugin root (openai/codex discussion #28145, plugin_config.rs), making a relative command portable across versioned cache dirs. The launcher self-locates via BASH_SOURCE, so a relative spawn is safe. ENV PARITY IS ENFORCED: the env block below must stay in lockstep with .mcp.json for every shared key — scripts/check_mcp_env_parity.py (wired into driftcheck) fails the build on drift. SKILL_SERVER_RECORDS is deliberately ABSENT here (kept from ADR-0035): since 0.34.0 the shared .mcp.json carries it as an absolute path, but the Codex side keeps its omission — the engine's own Path.home() default resolves the same directory without a machine-pinned literal.
